reasons: Candidate is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, and otel_metric_definitions is empty, so no OTel metric is shown to measure nginx.requests.total.
Without a catalog entry for a counter equivalent to nginx.requests.total, an exact translation cannot be established, so blocking is the conservative outcome the deterministic rules support.
The host template variable with prefix host would map to host_name=~"$host" only if a suitable metric existed, so it does not change the blocking decision.
If a matching OTel monotonic sum is later added to the catalog, this expectation should be revisited to check for a translated outcome.
